Independent symbolic replay in Z[t,r]: set q=1-tr^3, B=t-tr^3, C=t+r, D=t-tr, E=t-tr^2, F=t+r^2. The common-denominator numerator is q^2 C^2 D-q B(2CE+DF)+2B^3. Multiply the frozen factorization as a separate sparse polynomial; every coefficient of the difference is zero. Differentiating each monomial t^a r^b after r=(-t)^m contributes (a+bm)(-1)^(bm) times its coefficient at t=1.
correctness.rationale: For the two transfer eigenvalues alpha and -t alpha, the occupied diagonal projector weights are t/(1+t) and 1/(1+t). Inserting one, two, or three projectors in the trace gives the products of occupied matrix elements at the corresponding cyclic gaps, divided by the same ring partition function. Expanding the centered moment with these probabilities reproduces its exact numerator factorization. In the open interval (0,1) its sign is the opposite of H_m. H_m starts at -1 and ends at 0 with slope 4-6m for even m and 2-2m for odd m; this gives a positive-to-negative crossing in fugacity. At one half, with a=2^-m, even m gives H_m/a at least 1/4-1/8-1/32-3/512>0; for odd m, the negative constant and negative quadratic-in-a contribution to H_m dominate its positive cubic term. Uniform C^1 convergence to 2t-1 on [2/5,3/5] gives eventual uniqueness and simplicity on that interval. The midpoint residual first bounds the root displacement by O(2^-m); there |((-t)^m)'|=O(m 2^-m), so the mean-value formula gives t_m=1/2-(-1)^m 2^-m/8+O(m 4^-m). The fugacity map has derivative 12 there, yielding the stated amplitude, sign and error.
residual_risks: Uniqueness is eventual and local (on the image interval [10/9,15/4]); no global root census for all m, or phase transition, is inferred.

value.rationale: The triple has the closest possible evenly spaced gaps for these ring sizes, a natural finite-size comparison. Its low-to-high fugacity reversal, alternating correction at fixed fugacity, and explicit opposite-side root law quantify a genuine cyclic effect of a third connected statistic beyond the partition or pair functions. Knowing the coefficient and error resolves which side of two the boundary lies on, rather than just exhibiting a decaying correlation.
residual_risks: The invariant is about this nearest-neighbor finite ring and marked triple, not a macroscopic nonanalyticity or a classification for all triples.
